init.title: Zehnder Multicontroller options
init.description: With the climate entity enabled, setpoint, season, heating/cooling enable and fan speed are controlled through a single climate entity and are not created as separate number/switch entities. Disable it to get individual number and switch entities instead. Temperature and statistics sensors are created in both modes.
